estimand.control: the EXISTING Canonical Work Context + the EXISTING PriorResultContext, with NO Trajectory Section
estimand.treatment: the SAME existing Context + the source-qualified Trajectory Section, delivered through the attempt-bound boundary

requirements.UQ-1: baseline neither floor nor ceiling — the control must sit strictly between the worst and best outcomes
requirements.UQ-2: at least two outcome dimensions must vary under repetition of the control
requirements.UQ-3: at least one treatment-relevant failure class must vary
requirements.UQ-4: the candidate capital addresses an outcome that can vary
requirements.UQ-5: success cannot hinge entirely on one unrelated residual case

r2vrQualificationLaw.appliedNote: NOT yet applied: UQ-1..UQ-5 require stochastic baseline repetitions, which this stage does NOT run (§13.2).

futureParameters.provider: REQUIRED from the operator; NOT hard-coded
futureParameters.modelAndVersion: REQUIRED from the operator; NOT hard-coded
futureParameters.repetitionCount: REQUIRED (the baseline needs enough repetitions to establish whether any dimension varies)
futureParameters.taskFamily: FIX-A-GOVERNED-PARTIAL-CONTINUATION (Governed Rework Continuation over a PARTIAL page)
futureParameters.randomSeed: where the provider supports one, record it
futureParameters.failureClassification: per-trial outcome vector plus the delivery-precondition class
futureParameters.perCaseOutcomeVector: the three oracle dimensions per case, recorded separately
stopConditions: provider error rate above a declared threshold
a delivery-precondition failure rate that makes the treatment arm uninterpretable

attritionDiscipline.assignedArmIsTheDenominator: a future TREATMENT trial with FAILED delivery remains in the ASSIGNED-arm record and is NOT counted as successfully delivered Treatment (§13.4)
attritionDiscipline.perProtocolVsAssignedArm: any per-protocol analysis must be clearly distinguished from an assigned-arm analysis

permittedFinalStatements: the treatment exposure path is source-qualified at the CONTROLLED level
